root_cause_class: RC2 / WP2.3 user-private Agora servant visibility on persona GET subroutes
implementation: services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py: new _ensure_persona_readable(persona_id, viewer_user_id, caller_tenant=None, *, require_exists=True), the read variant of _ensure_persona_exists. It reads the directory once, returns when _persona_fleet_record_visible_to(record, None) is true (record not user_private, no scope resolution), otherwise resolves the viewer lazily and applies _persona_fleet_record_visible_to again; a rejected record raises the same 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND ('Persona not found' / 'Persona {id} does not exist') as a missing persona. No second visibility rule.

services/control-plane/bff/personas/routes/collection.py: _fleet_viewer_resolver (lazy wrapper over the existing _fleet_viewer_user_id) and _ensure_persona_readable_by(identity, persona_id, utc_now, *, tenant_id, require_exists), the one route-side entry point.
personas/routes/detail.py: the 9 GET routes replace _ensure_persona_exists with _ensure_persona_readable_by (same position, after _require_read_role).

personas/routes/lifecycle.py: GET strategy-pool/publish-history uses _ensure_persona_readable_by after _pool_owner_authorization (original order); the pool-publish service principal keeps _ensure_persona_exists because it reads its own publication record and is not a viewer. GET strategy-matches passes a lazy viewer into _persona_strategy_matches_response -> _persona_strategy_discovery_payload, which calls _ensure_persona_readable instead of _ensure_persona_exists when a viewer is supplied (single directory read); POST strategy-discovery passes none and is unchanged.

trade_journal.py: create_trade_journal_router takes optional ensure_persona_readable(identity, persona_id), called in read_owner after require_read_role and _allowed and before bound_tenant and any owner call. core/app_factory.py wires it to _ensure_persona_readable_by(..., require_exists=False), so a persona absent from the directory keeps the telemetry/persona owner's answer.
BFF_API_CONTRACT.md states the owner rule for the 15 routes.

tests/test_persona_pool_publish_route.py: the _client fixture also stubs _ensure_persona_readable_by next to the existing _ensure_persona_exists stub (fixture only; the publish-history tests otherwise hit the real directory).

write_routes_unchanged.evidence: POST /bff/personas/{id}/strategy-pool/publish and POST .../test-prompt in personas/routes/lifecycle.py still call _ensure_persona_exists; POST strategy-discovery still reaches _ensure_persona_exists inside _persona_strategy_discovery_payload (no viewer passed); detail.py has no remaining _ensure_persona_exists. Asserted in test_read_check_reuses_shared_visibility_rule_and_write_routes_keep_existence_check.
write_routes_unchanged.trade_journal_commands: command() and its _allowed / require_operator_role checks are not touched.

acceptance_evidence.AC1: tests/test_persona_subroute_private_visibility.py::test_non_owner_gets_missing_persona_404_and_no_owner_call and test_owner_still_answered are parametrized over all 15 routes; test_non_owner_404_is_identical_to_missing_persona_on_persona_routes compares the non-owner body with a genuinely missing persona on the 11 persona-router routes. The trade-journal episode route answers the owner with the telemetry owner's own 404 (the stub reports no episode) and the non-owner with the persona 404.
acceptance_evidence.AC2: Visibility is _persona_fleet_record_visible_to + _fleet_viewer_user_id through one shared check (_ensure_persona_readable); routes only call _ensure_persona_readable_by. Write routes unchanged (see write_routes_unchanged).
acceptance_evidence.AC3: test_unscoped_and_trading_personas_unchanged_without_scope_resolution (15 routes x {trading persona, servant without owner_scope/visibility_scope}) answers as before with 0 scope resolutions; test_trade_journal_missing_persona_keeps_owner_answer keeps the owner answer for a persona absent from the directory.
acceptance_evidence.AC4: For every rejected non-owner request the counters for memory, audit, telemetry, persona-owner, pool history, route policy, activity, evaluations, capability snapshot, runtime profile and strategy discovery stay 0 (asserted per route).
acceptance_evidence.AC5: BFF_API_CONTRACT.md: new bullet next to the GET /bff/personas owner-visibility bullet.
acceptance_evidence.AC8: Owner Claude2 (Anthropic) and reviewer Codex2 (OpenAI) are different model families.
